request.style: English, solo male baritone voice, warm and dignified, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, light percussion, majestic and reverent mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Among the thirty brave men stood
A name recorded in the book
Hezro the Carmelite was found
In David's mighty company

[Verse]
No spear or battle is named for him
No kill is written in the text
He stands among the heroes then
In the list of those who served

[Verse]
Chronicled again we see
The same name in the scroll
Hezro the Carmelite appears
In the record of the bold

[Verse]
Part of the elite group they were
Loyal to the king of old
Serving in the army days
When the kingdom grew strong

[Outro]
Hezro the Carmelite is named
